# Elite Frontend Image Direction Skill for Muse

Frontend art direction for image generation with one ironclad rule: one separate horizontal image per website section, never collapsed into a single tall slice. Enforces a combinatorial variation engine (theme paradigm, background mode, typography character, hero architecture, section system), brief-to-direction mapping (minimalist / editorial / cinematic / SaaS / agency / e-commerce), conversion-aware structure, one disciplined palette across all frames, and an extensive anti-AI-slop checklist (no default purple gradients, no cloned left-text/right-image heroes, no fake KPI strips). Each generated image is meant to be an implementation-friendly reference a developer or coding model can build from. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: you need a Muse environment that can generate images; generating a full 8-section page means 8 image calls, which consumes generation budget — and these are design comps, not production code. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
